subject: Superintendent Evaluation Rubric Indicators
overview: The committee identified nine focus indicators from the state rubric to serve as the basis for the Superintendent's annual evaluation and established a new subcommittee to manage the review process.

items.title: Standard 1: Instructional Leadership
items.summary: Approved indicators B (Instruction) and E (Data-Informed Decision-Making) as focus areas for the instructional leadership standard.

items.title: Standard 2: Management and Operations
items.summary: Selected indicator A (Environment) for the management and operations standard.

items.title: Standard 3: Family and Community Engagement
items.summary: Approved indicators A (Engagement), B (Sharing Responsibility), and C (Communication) for the family and community engagement standard.

items.title: Standard 4: Professional Culture
items.summary: Selected indicators A (Commitment to High Standards), B (Cultural Proficiency), and F (Managing Conflict) for the professional culture standard.

items.title: Evaluation Ratings and Data
items.summary: Voted to use descriptive DESE ratings instead of numbers and decided to include raw member data alongside the final summary evaluation.

items.title: Establishment of Evaluation Subcommittee
items.summary: Created a new standing Evaluation Subcommittee and appointed Members Graham, Hays, and McLaughlin to serve, with Hays designated as Chair.
